title: Named requirements - AI/ML applied research internship
purpose: The posting states its hard requirements explicitly. Exactly four canonical skills appear in the whole text, which makes the skill-overlap ratio against each resume reproducible by hand rather than a number the reader has to take on trust.
text:
Applied Research Intern - Ranking Models
Acme Corp, Singapore - six months, on site

Requirements
- Python, for reading and changing existing code
- PyTorch, for training a model end to end
- SQL, for answering a question from a table
- Statistics, for judging whether a difference is real

You will train and evaluate ranking models, write up experiments so a
colleague can reproduce them, and present findings to the recruiting team
once a fortnight.
notes: This posting was first written as four paragraphs of narrative prose. That version measured 0.334 on the rescaled retrieval scale - below the 0.4 abstention threshold - so every tailored field abstained and the matrix was measuring the posting's writing style rather than the assistant. The shape is therefore stated explicitly and the measured score recorded, so a later run can tell which regime it is in. The phrase 'machine learning' is deliberately absent: it is a canonical skill token, and its presence would raise the overlap denominator from four to five and make the documented 1/4 figure wrong.
